text: 上期所：《上海期货交易所实际控制关系账户管理办法》（修订案）经上海期货交易所理事会审议通过，并已报告中国证监会，现予以发布，自2026年10月20日起实施
text_en: SHFE: The revised Administrative Measures for Accounts with Actual Control Relationships of the Shanghai Futures Exchange was deliberated and approved by the SHFE Council and has been reported to the CSRC; it is hereby issued and will take effect on October 20, 2026
